inspectdb already generates a related_name for repeated relations to the same model. When the target model is already in used_relations, it sets extra_params["related_name"] = "<modelname lowercased>_<att_name>_set". The first relation to a model gets no related_name, and every later one does, which avoids the fields.E304 clash.
